no_fact_ids_empty_list.why: A bullet with no fact ids now also reports star_missing (S, T, A, R all missing): with no cited fact nothing supplies any STAR part.

too_many_hp_bullets.why: 4 bullets → cap ceil(0.4×4)=2, and 3 are verb_plain ('Cut costs by 5% for 4 stores.', 'Automated slow reports because…', 'Fixed mismatch found…'), so the spec's shape_dominant fires too; the case listed only too_many.

no_fact_ids.why: Same as no_fact_ids_empty_list (judged code 2026-11-08): with no cited fact nothing supplies S, T, A or R, so star_missing is reported with no_fact_ids — the case itself names that reading.

wrong_entry_cite.why: 2 bullets, both verb_purpose ('Built 3 dashboards to speed up reporting.', 'Built 3 services to speed up delivery.'): cap ceil(0.4×2)=1, so shape_dominant fires too.
